[For the host/ImGui + core-build owner â€” NOMINMAX sign-off, from gissa/opus-wynn. Yes/no; I will NOT act either way until you respond.]

QUESTION: add `add_compile_definitions(NOMINMAX WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN)` to the MSVC block in host/CMakeLists.txt, matching core/ and ui/imgui/?

CURRENT STATE (audit): NOMINMAX is project-wide (MSVC) in core/CMakeLists.txt:32 + ui/imgui/CMakeLists.txt:13, plus per-file (#define before <windows.h>, #ifndef-guarded) in platform/dialogs_win32.cpp, host/src/ui/file_dialog.cpp, core/prof/sampler.cpp, core/geom/text.cpp, core/doc/formats.cpp (x3). NOT set project-wide in host/CMakeLists.txt (MSVC block :6 = only /utf-8 /MP). Without it, <windows.h> min()/max() macros clobber std::min/max/numeric_limits â€” documented casualties: core/api/libaicad.cpp (windows.h via OCCT) + formats.cpp PLY reader; symptom C2589/C2059. Host builds clean TODAY (build.bat host exit 0) only because its windows.h includes sit behind per-file guards.

CHANGE RISK (separate): adding = zero functional risk (no-op where windows.h absent; #ifndef guards keep it silent; pairs w/ WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN). NOT adding = fragile: first host TU that pulls windows.h + uses std::min/max breaks w/ a non-obvious C2589.

RECOMMENDATION (my read): yes â€” one line, hardening, matches the other two targets. But it's YOUR CMakeLists â€” your call. No edit made.
